Description: Creates the lab environment for the workshop

Source.BuildSpec:
version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
  variables:
    REQUESTED_ACTION: Create
    KUBERNETES_VERSION: "1.32"
    HELM_VERSION: ""
    AWS_REGION: ""
    RETAIL_STORE_APP_HELM_CHART_VERSION: ""
    NODE_ROLE: ""
    CLUSTER_ROLE: ""
    CLUSTER_NAME: ""
    MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME: ""
phases:
  install:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands: |
      set -e

      # Uninstall AWS CLI v1
      pip3 uninstall -y awscli

      # AWS CLI v2
      curl -Lqs https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip
      unzip -o -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp/awscliv2
      /tmp/awscliv2/aws/install --bin-dir /usr/local/bin --install-dir /usr/local/aws-cli --update
      rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/awscliv2
      aws --version

      # Helm
      curl -Lqs https://get.helm.sh/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
      tar --strip-components=1 -C /usr/bin -xzf /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz linux-amd64/helm
      chmod +x /usr/bin/helm
      rm -rf /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
      helm version

      # for ARM systems, set ARCH to: `arm64`, `armv6` or `armv7`
      ARCH=amd64
      PLATFORM=$(uname -s)_$ARCH

      curl -sLO "https://github.com/eksctl-io/eksctl/releases/latest/download/eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz"

      # (Optional) Verify checksum
      curl -sL "https://github.com/eksctl-io/eksctl/releases/latest/download/eksctl_checksums.txt" | grep $PLATFORM | sha256sum --check

      tar -xzf eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz -C /tmp && rm eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz

      sudo mv /tmp/eksctl /usr/local/bin
  pre_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands: |
      set -e

      export AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query "Account" --output text)
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -e
        set -o pipefail

        if [[ $REQUESTED_ACTION == 'Delete' ]]; then
          echo "Requested Action: Delete"

          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${CLUSTER_NAME}

          kubectl delete svc catalog-nlb || true
          kubectl delete ingress --all

          ######## HELM RELEASES ######## 
          # Get all Helm releases in all namespaces
          RELEASES=$(helm list --all-namespaces --output json | jq -c '.[]')
          if [ -z "$RELEASES" ]; then
            echo "No Helm releases found in the cluster."
          else
            echo "Uninstalling all Helm releases..."
            # Loop through each release and uninstall it
            echo "$RELEASES" | while IFS= read -r release; do
              RELEASE_NAME=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.name')
              NAMESPACE=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.namespace')
              echo "Uninstalling release '$RELEASE_NAME' from namespace '$NAMESPACE'..."
              helm uninstall "$RELEASE_NAME" -n "$NAMESPACE"
            done
          fi    
          ######## HELM RELEASES ########

          eksctl delete cluster  --name ${CLUSTER_NAME} --region ${AWS_REGION}

        else
          echo "Requested Action: ${REQUESTED_ACTION}"

          # Create a bare EKS cluster - no addons & auto-mode disabled

          cat <<EOF| eksctl create cluster -f -
          apiVersion: eksctl.io/v1alpha5
          kind: ClusterConfig
          metadata:
            name: ${CLUSTER_NAME}
            region: ${AWS_REGION}
            version: "${KUBERNETES_VERSION}"
            tags:
              provisioned-by: eks-automode-workshop
          availabilityZones:
        $(aws ec2 describe-availability-zones \
            --region ${AWS_REGION} \
            --filters "Name=opt-in-status,Values=opt-in-not-required" \
            --query "AvailabilityZones[?ZoneId!='use1-az3'].[ZoneName][:3]" \
            --output text | sed 's/ /, /g; s/^/   - /')
          iam:
            withOIDC: true
            serviceRoleARN: ${CLUSTER_ROLE}
          addonsConfig:
            disableDefaultAddons: true
          managedNodeGroups: []
          cloudWatch:
            clusterLogging:
              enableTypes: ["*"]
        EOF
        fi

        eksctl get clusters

version: 0.2
env:
  shell: bash
  variables:
    REQUESTED_ACTION: Create
    HELM_VERSION: ""
    AWS_REGION: ""
    RETAIL_STORE_APP_HELM_CHART_VERSION: 1.1.0
    NODE_ROLE: ""
    FARGATE_ROLE: ""
    CLUSTER_ROLE: ""
    CLUSTER_NAME: ""
    MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME: ""
    KUBERNETES_VERSION: "1.33"
    KARPENTER_VERSION: 1.5.0
    KARPENTER_NAMESPACE: kube-system
    AWS_PARTITION: aws
phases:
  install:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -e
        pip3 uninstall -y awscli
        curl -Lqs https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip
        unzip -o -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp/awscliv2
        /tmp/awscliv2/aws/install --bin-dir /usr/local/bin --install-dir /usr/local/aws-cli --update
        rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/awscliv2
        aws --version
        curl -Lqs https://get.helm.sh/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
        tar --strip-components=1 -C /usr/bin -xzf /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz linux-amd64/helm
        chmod +x /usr/bin/helm
        rm -rf /tmp/helm-v${HELM_VERSION}-linux-amd64.tar.gz
        helm version
        ARCH=amd64
        PLATFORM=$(uname -s)_$ARCH
        curl -sLO "https://github.com/eksctl-io/eksctl/releases/latest/download/eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz"
        curl -sL "https://github.com/eksctl-io/eksctl/releases/latest/download/eksctl_checksums.txt" | grep $PLATFORM | sha256sum --check
        tar -xzf eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz -C /tmp && rm eksctl_$PLATFORM.tar.gz
        sudo mv /tmp/eksctl /usr/local/bin
  pre_build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -e
        export AWS_ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query "Account" --output text)
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - |
        set -e
        set -o pipefail

        if [[ $REQUESTED_ACTION == 'Delete' ]]; then
          echo "Requested Action: Delete"
          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
          # Delete all ingress objects
          kubectl delete ingress --all -n apps
          ######## HELM RELEASES ########
          # Get all Helm releases in all namespaces
          RELEASES=$(helm list --all-namespaces --output json | jq -c '.[]')

          if [ -z "$RELEASES" ]; then
            echo "No Helm releases found in the cluster."
          else
            echo "Uninstalling all Helm releases..."

            # Loop through each release and uninstall it
            echo "$RELEASES" | while IFS= read -r release; do
              RELEASE_NAME=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.name')
              if [ "$RELEASE_NAME" != "karpenter" ]; then
                NAMESPACE=$(echo "$release" | jq -r '.namespace')

                echo "Uninstalling release '$RELEASE_NAME' from namespace '$NAMESPACE'..."
                helm uninstall "$RELEASE_NAME" -n "$NAMESPACE"
              else
                echo "Skipping Helm release: $RELEASE_NAME (excluded)"
              fi
            done
          fi
          ######## HELM RELEASES ########

          ######## FARGATE PROFILES ########
          # Get all Fargate profiles in the cluster
          FARGATE_PROFILES=$(eksctl get fargateprofile --cluster "$MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME" -o json | jq -r '.[].name')

          if [ -z "$FARGATE_PROFILES" ]; then
            echo "No Fargate profiles found in the cluster: $MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME"
          else
            # Loop through and delete each Fargate profile
            echo "Deleting Fargate profiles in cluster: $MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME"
            for PROFILE in $FARGATE_PROFILES; do
              echo "Deleting Fargate profile: $PROFILE"
              eksctl delete fargateprofile --cluster "$MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME" --name "$PROFILE" --wait
            done
            echo "All Fargate profiles have been deleted."
          fi
          ######## FARGATE PROFILES ########

          ######## MANAGED NODE GROUPS ########
          # Get all managed node groups in the cluster
          MANAGED_NODE_GROUPS=$(eksctl get nodegroup --cluster "$MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME" -o json | jq -r '.[] | select(.Type == "managed") | .Name')

          if [ -z "$MANAGED_NODE_GROUPS" ]; then
            echo "No managed node groups found in the cluster: $MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME"
          else
            echo "Deleting managed node groups in cluster: $MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME"
            # Loop through and delete each managed node group
            echo "$MANAGED_NODE_GROUPS" | while IFS= read -r nodegroup; do
              echo "Deleting managed node group: $nodegroup"
              eksctl delete nodegroup --cluster "$MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME" --name "$nodegroup" --region "$REGION" --disable-eviction --parallel 25 --wait
            done
            echo "All managed node groups have been deleted."
          fi
          ######## MANAGED NODE GROUPS ########
          ######## KARPENTER ########
          kubectl delete nodeclaim --all --wait=true --timeout=10m
          helm uninstall karpenter -n ${KARPENTER_NAMESPACE} --wait --timeout=10m || true
          ######## KARPENTER ########
          # remove orphaned ENIs
          aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \
            --filters "Name=tag:cluster.k8s.amazonaws.com/name,Values=${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" "Name=status,Values=available" \
            --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].NetworkInterfaceId' \
            --output text | tr '\t' '\n' | \
          while read -r eni; do
            if [ ! -z "$eni" ]; then
              echo "Deleting network interface: $eni"
              aws ec2 delete-network-interface --network-interface-id "$eni"
            fi
          done
          eksctl delete cluster --name "$MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME" --region "$AWS_REGION" --wait
          POLICY_NAME="AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMPolicy"
          # Check if the policy already exists
          POLICY_ARN=$(aws iam list-policies --scope Local --query "Policies[?PolicyName=='$POLICY_NAME'].Arn" --output text)
          aws iam delete-policy --policy-arn $POLICY_ARN || true
          # Delete Karpenter instance profiles
          KARPENTER_NODE_ROLE=KarpenterNodeRole-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
          KARPENTER_INSTANCE_PROFILES=$(aws iam list-instance-profiles-for-role --role-name ${KARPENTER_NODE_ROLE} --query 'InstanceProfiles[*].InstanceProfileName' --output text || true)
          for profile in $KARPENTER_INSTANCE_PROFILES; do
            echo "Removing role from instance profile $profile"
            aws iam remove-role-from-instance-profile --instance-profile-name "$profile" --role-name ${KARPENTER_NODE_ROLE}
            echo "Deleting instance profile $profile"
            aws iam delete-instance-profile --instance-profile-name "$profile"
          done

          aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name "Karpenter-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" --region $AWS_REGION || true
          aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete --stack-name "Karpenter-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" --region $AWS_REGION || true

        else
          echo "Requested Action: ${REQUESTED_ACTION}"

          # Karpenter installation
          TEMPOUT=$CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/tmp-karpenter
          touch $TEMPOUT

          # for local testing --> run create cluster command only if cluster doesn't exists
          if ! aws eks describe-cluster --name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME} >/dev/null 2>&1; then

            # required resources for Karpenter
            curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/karpenter-provider-aws/v"${KARPENTER_VERSION}"/website/content/en/preview/getting-started/getting-started-with-karpenter/cloudformation.yaml  > "${TEMPOUT}" \
            && aws cloudformation deploy \
              --stack-name "Karpenter-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" \
              --template-file "${TEMPOUT}" \
              --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM \
              --parameter-overrides "ClusterName=${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}"

            curl -o iam-policy.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubernetes-sigs/aws-load-balancer-controller/main/docs/install/iam_policy.json
            POLICY_NAME="AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMPolicy"

            # Check if the policy already exists
            POLICY_ARN=$(aws iam list-policies --scope Local --query "Policies[?PolicyName=='$POLICY_NAME'].Arn" --output text)
            if [ -z "$POLICY_ARN" ]; then
                echo "Policy does not exist. Creating policy..."
                POLICY_ARN=$(aws iam create-policy \
                    --policy-name "$POLICY_NAME" \
                    --policy-document file://iam-policy.json \
                    --query "Policy.Arn" --output text)
                echo "Policy created: $POLICY_ARN"
            else
                echo "Policy already exists: $POLICY_ARN"
            fi

            # Create EKS Cluster for the migration module
            cat <<EOF| eksctl create cluster -f -
            apiVersion: eksctl.io/v1alpha5
            kind: ClusterConfig
            metadata:
              name: ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
              region: ${AWS_REGION}
              version: "${KUBERNETES_VERSION}"
              tags:
                karpenter.sh/discovery: ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
                provisioned-by: eks-automode-workshop
            availabilityZones:
        $(aws ec2 describe-availability-zones \
              --region ${AWS_REGION} \
              --filters "Name=opt-in-status,Values=opt-in-not-required" \
              --query "AvailabilityZones[?ZoneId!='use1-az3'].[ZoneName][:3]" \
              --output text | sed 's/ /, /g; s/^/      - /')
            iam:
              withOIDC: true
              serviceRoleARN: ${CLUSTER_ROLE}
              podIdentityAssociations:
              - namespace: "${KARPENTER_NAMESPACE}"
                serviceAccountName: karpenter
                roleName: ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}-karpenter
                permissionPolicyARNs:
                - arn:${AWS_PARTITION}:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:policy/KarpenterControllerPolicy-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
              - namespace: kube-system
                serviceAccountName: aws-load-balancer-controller
                roleName: AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMRole
                permissionPolicyARNs:
                - arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:policy/AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMPolicy
            accessConfig:
              authenticationMode: API_AND_CONFIG_MAP
              accessEntries:
                - principalARN: "arn:aws:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:role/KarpenterNodeRole-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}"
                  type: EC2_LINUX
            managedNodeGroups:
              - name: system-mng
                instanceType: m6g.large
                privateNetworking: true
                desiredCapacity: 3
                minSize: 0
                maxSize: 3
                labels:
                  role: system-mng
                taints:
                  - key: CriticalAddonsOnly
                    effect: NoSchedule
                tags:
                  provisioned-by: eks-automode-workshop
              - name: apps-mng
                instanceType: m5.large
                privateNetworking: true
                desiredCapacity: 3
                minSize: 0
                maxSize: 3
                labels:
                  role: apps-mng
                taints:
                  - key: role
                    value: apps-mng
                    effect: NoSchedule
                tags:
                  provisioned-by: eks-automode-workshop
            cloudWatch:
              clusterLogging:
                enableTypes: ["*"]
            addons:
            - name: coredns
              configurationValues: |-
                nodeSelector:
                  role: system-mng
            - name: eks-pod-identity-agent
            - name: aws-ebs-csi-driver
        EOF

          for i in {1..20}; do
              echo "Creating Fargate Profile: apps (attempt $i/20)"
              if aws eks create-fargate-profile \
                  --cluster-name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME} \
                  --fargate-profile-name apps \
                  --pod-execution-role-arn ${FARGATE_ROLE} \
                  --selectors namespace=apps,labels='{app.kubernetes.io/component=service,app.kubernetes.io/name=orders}' \
                  --tags provisioned-by=eks-automode-workshop; then
                  echo "Fargate profile created successfully!"
                  break
              elif [ $i -eq 20 ]; then
                  echo "Failed to create Fargate profile after 20 attempts. Aborting."
                  exit 1
              else
                  echo "Attempt $i failed, retrying in 60 seconds..."
                  sleep 60
              fi
          done

          echo "Waiting for Fargate Profile apps to be ACTIVE"
          aws eks wait fargate-profile-active --cluster-name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME} --fargate-profile-name apps
          aws eks describe-fargate-profile --cluster-name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME} --fargate-profile-name apps
          echo "Fargate Profile apps is ACTIVE"

          fi

          aws eks update-kubeconfig --name ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}

          echo "aws sts get-caller-identity"
          aws sts get-caller-identity

          echo "kubectl get pods -A"
          kubectl get pods -A

          # EKS Charts
          echo "1 - helm repo registry logout"
          helm registry logout public.ecr.aws || true
          echo "helm repo add"
          helm repo add eks https://aws.github.io/eks-charts
          echo "helm repo update"
          helm repo update
          echo "2 - helm repo registry logout"
          helm registry logout public.ecr.aws || true

          # install Karpenter
          export CLUSTER_ENDPOINT="$(aws eks describe-cluster --name "${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" --query "cluster.endpoint" --output text)"
          export KARPENTER_IAM_ROLE_ARN="arn:${AWS_PARTITION}:iam::${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID}:role/${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}-karpenter"
          echo "vars:" $CLUSTER_ENDPOINT " and " $KARPENTER_IAM_ROLE_ARN

          echo "helm upgrade -i karpenter"
          helm upgrade -i karpenter oci://public.ecr.aws/karpenter/karpenter --version "${KARPENTER_VERSION}" --namespace "${KARPENTER_NAMESPACE}" --create-namespace \
            --set "settings.clusterName=${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" \
            --set "settings.interruptionQueue=${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}" \
            --set controller.resources.requests.cpu=1 \
            --set controller.resources.requests.memory=1Gi \
            --set controller.resources.limits.cpu=1 \
            --set controller.resources.limits.memory=1Gi \
            --wait

          VPC_ID=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters "Name=tag:Name,Values=eksctl-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}-cluster/VPC" --query "Vpcs[*].VpcId" --output text)
          # install AWS LBC
          cat <<EOF > lbc-values.yaml
          vpcId: ${VPC_ID}
          region: ${AWS_REGION}
          clusterName: ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
          serviceAccount:
            create: true
            name: aws-load-balancer-controller
          nodeSelector:
            role: system-mng
          tolerations:
            - key: CriticalAddonsOnly
              operator: Exists
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
        EOF

          wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/eks-charts/master/stable/aws-load-balancer-controller/crds/crds.yaml
          kubectl apply -f crds.yaml

          echo "helm upgrade -i lbc"
          helm upgrade -i aws-load-balancer-controller eks/aws-load-balancer-controller \
            --namespace kube-system \
            --wait \
            --values lbc-values.yaml

          # self-managed karpenter ec2nodeclass
          cat <<EOF| kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: karpenter.k8s.aws/v1
          kind: EC2NodeClass
          metadata:
            name: apps
          spec:
            amiSelectorTerms:
              - alias: al2023@latest
            role: KarpenterNodeRole-${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
            subnetSelectorTerms:
              - tags:
                  karpenter.sh/discovery: ${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}
                  Name: "*/SubnetPrivate*"
            securityGroupSelectorTerms:
              - tags:
                  # ensure that the cluster SG is used, as AWS LBC is looking for this tag key
                  # see https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/aws-load-balancer-controller/blob/v2.11.0/pkg/targetgroupbinding/networking_manager.go#L552
                  kubernetes.io/cluster/${MIGRATION_CLUSTER_NAME}: owned
            tags:
              provisioned-by: eks-automode-workshop
        EOF
          # self-managed karpenter nodepool
          cat <<EOF| kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1
          kind: NodePool
          metadata:
            name: apps
          spec:
            disruption:
              consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized
              consolidateAfter: 30s
            template:
              metadata:
                labels:
                  role: apps-karpenter
              spec:
                nodeClassRef:
                  group: karpenter.k8s.aws
                  kind: EC2NodeClass
                  name: apps
                taints:
                  - key: role
                    value: apps-karpenter
                    effect: NoSchedule
                requirements:
                  - key: kubernetes.io/arch
                    operator: In
                    values: [amd64, arm64]
                  - key: kubernetes.io/os
                    operator: In
                    values: [linux]
                  - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
                    operator: In
                    values: [on-demand]
                  - key: node.kubernetes.io/instance-category
                    operator: In
                    values: [c, m, r]
                  - key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-generation
                    operator: Gt
                    values: ['4']
                  - key: karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-size
                    operator: NotIn
                    values: [nano, micro, small, medium]
        EOF

          # Create default gp3 SC
          cat << EOF > $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/storage-class.yml
          kind: StorageClass
          apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
          metadata:
            name: gp3
            annotations:
              storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: 'true'
          provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
          allowVolumeExpansion: true
          reclaimPolicy: Retain
          volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
          parameters:
            type: gp3
            fsType: ext4
        EOF

          kubectl apply -f $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/storage-class.yml

          # Create the apps Namespace
          kubectl create namespace apps

          # Install orders --> AppsMNG
          cat <<EOF> $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/orders-values.yaml
          replicaCount: 3

          topologySpreadConstraints:
            - maxSkew: 1
              minDomains: 3
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
              whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/instance: retail-store-app-orders
        EOF

          helm upgrade -i retail-store-app-orders oci://public.ecr.aws/aws-containers/retail-store-sample-orders-chart \
          --version ${RETAIL_STORE_APP_HELM_CHART_VERSION} \
          --namespace apps \
          --values $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/orders-values.yaml

          # Install catalog --> AppsMNG
          cat <<EOF> $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/catalog-values.yaml
          replicaCount: 3
          nodeSelector:
            role: apps-mng
          tolerations:
            - key: role
              value: apps-mng
              operator: Equal
              effect: NoSchedule

          app:
            persistence:
              provider: mysql
              endpoint: ""
              database: "catalog"

              secret:
                create: true
                name: catalog-db
                username: catalog
                password: "mysqlcatalog123" # Password has to match the content in the migration module for the catalog service

          topologySpreadConstraints:
            - maxSkew: 1
              minDomains: 3
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
              whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/instance: retail-store-app-catalog

          mysql:
            create: true
            nodeSelector:
              role: apps-mng
            tolerations:
              - key: role
                value: apps-mng
                operator: Equal
                effect: NoSchedule
            persistentVolume:
              enabled: true
              accessModes:
                - ReadWriteOnce
              size: 10Gi
              storageClass: "gp3"
        EOF

          helm upgrade -i retail-store-app-catalog oci://public.ecr.aws/aws-containers/retail-store-sample-catalog-chart \
            --version ${RETAIL_STORE_APP_HELM_CHART_VERSION} \
            --namespace apps \
            --values $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/catalog-values.yaml

          # Install Checkout --> self-managed karpenter
          cat <<EOF> $CODEBUILD_SRC_DIR/checkout-values.yaml
          replicaCount: 3
          nodeSelector:
            role: apps-karpenter
          tolerations:
            - key: role
              value: apps-karpenter
              operator: Equal
              effect: NoSchedule
          topologySpreadConstraints:
            - maxSkew: 1
              minDomains: 3
              topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
              whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/instance: retail-store-app-checkout

          redis:
            nodeSelector:
              role: apps-karpenter
            tolerations:
              - key: role
                value: apps-karpenter

from __future__ import print_function
import boto3
import json
import os
import time
import traceback
import cfnresponse
from botocore.exceptions import WaiterError

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    print('Event: {}'.format(event))
    print('context: {}'.format(context))
    responseData = {}

    status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS

    if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
        responseData = {'Success': 'Custom Resource removed'}
        cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, responseData, 'CustomResourcePhysicalID')
    else:
        try:
            # Open AWS clients
            ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
            ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

            instance_id = event['ResourceProperties']['InstanceId']

            print('Waiting for the instance to be ready...')
            # Wait for Instance to become ready
            instance_state = 'unknown'
            print('Instance is currently in state'.format(instance_state))
            while instance_state != 'running':
                time.sleep(5)
                di = ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
                instance_state = di['Reservations'][0]['Instances'][0]['State']['Name']
                print('Waiting for instance in state: {}'.format(instance_state))

            print('Instance is ready')

            print('Waiting for instance to come online in SSM...')
            for i in range(1, 60):
              response = ssm.describe_instance_information(Filters=[{'Key': 'InstanceIds', 'Values': [instance_id]}])
              if len(response["InstanceInformationList"]) == 0:
                print('No instances in SSM')
              elif len(response["InstanceInformationList"]) > 0 and \
                    response["InstanceInformationList"][0]["PingStatus"] == "Online" and \
                    response["InstanceInformationList"][0]["InstanceId"] == instance_id:
                print('Instance is online in SSM')
                break
              time.sleep(10)

            ssm_document = event['ResourceProperties']['SsmDocument']

            ssm.send_command(
                InstanceIds=[instance_id],
                DocumentName=ssm_document,
                CloudWatchOutputConfig={
                    'CloudWatchLogGroupName': event['ResourceProperties']['LogGroupName'],
                    'CloudWatchOutputEnabled': True
                })

            responseData = {'Success': 'Started bootstrapping for instance: '+instance_id}
        except Exception as e:
            status = cfnresponse.FAILED
            tb_err = traceback.format_exc()
            print(tb_err)
            responseData = {'Error': tb_err}
        finally:
            cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, responseData, 'CustomResourcePhysicalID')
